definition: שַׁלִּיט adjective having mastery, domineering ; — 1. having mastery: בָּרוּחַ ׳ אֵין אָדָם שׁ Eccl 8:8 elsewhere as substantive ׳ הַשּׁ the ruler Eccl 10:5 , so (with עַלהָֿאָרֶץ ) Gen 42:6 (probably late substitution for original word of E ); plural as substantive שַׁלִּיטִים Eccl 7:19 (specifically of Alexander's successors Perles Anal. 42 ). 2. domineering, imperious , feminine singular ( Kö ii. 10. 201 ) אִשָּׁה זוֺנָה שַׁלָּ֑טֶת Ezek 16:30 (Jerusalem personified).

BDB8720 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB8722

שַׁלִּיט adjective having mastery, domineering; —

1. having mastery: בָּרוּחַ ׳אֵין אָדָם שׁ Eccl 8:8 elsewhere as substantive ׳הַשּׁ the ruler Eccl 10:5, so (with עַלהָֿאָרֶץ) Gen 42:6 (probably late substitution for original word of E); plural as substantive שַׁלִּיטִים Eccl 7:19 (specifically of Alexander's successors PerlesAnal. 42).
2. domineering, imperious, feminine singular (Kö ii. 10. 201) אִשָּׁה זוֺנָה שַׁלָּ֑טֶת Ezek 16:30 (Jerusalem personified).
